Senior Platform Engineer, Fabrikam Cloud

We are looking for a senior engineer to build and run the services behind our payments platform.

What you will do
- Design Python services that handle millions of events a day.
- Run our workloads on Kubernetes and own their deployment pipelines.
- Write and tune SQL for PostgreSQL at scale.
- Lead incident reviews and mentor other engineers.

What you bring
- Five or more years of backend development in Python.
- Production experience with Kubernetes, Helm and container security.
- Event streaming with Kafka or a similar system.
- Clear written communication.
